units.source_text: 柏木用手指捅了捅我的后背。

en.t: Kashiwagi poked me in the back with his finger.

units.source_text: 我便跨过低矮的石墙，纵身跳到马路上。

en.t: I stepped over the low stone wall and leapt down onto the road.
A height of two feet was nothing.

units.source_text: 但是，紧接着，生就一双X型的腿的棺木发出了可怕的叫声，摔倒在我的身旁。

en.t: But immediately afterward, Kashiwagi, born with a pair of X-shaped legs, let out a terrible cry and fell beside me.

units.source_text: 当然，他是没有跳好才摔倒的。

en.t: Of course, he fell because he had failed to jump properly.
